Core Architectural Principles:

1. Orthogonal Rail Navigation: Articulated overhead robots travel strictly along the X and Y axes of the electrified ceiling grid (making 90° turns at intersections) with zero battery downtime.

2. Multi-Size Cube & Pallet Consolidation: Supports 1m×1m, 1m×0.5m (2 per pallet layer), and 0.5m×0.5m (4 per pallet layer) containers, maximizing both storage density and pallet fill rates.

3. Direct Overhead Hoist Delivery: The active ceiling extends over the open staging zone, where robots vertically lower outbound orders directly onto picking pallets and retrieve inbound freight.
